title: Equation consistency in electron-only reconnection
author: Taylor Kalin

source.title: Electron-only magnetic reconnection and inverse magnetic-energy transfer at sub-ion scales
source.identity_semantics: Recorded source identities, not rehashed by this offline program. The authentic CHORUS accepted manuscript is not the uninspected subscription VOR. Supplement checks refer only to arXiv v2.

scope: Printed-equation consistency of named editions; synthetic instantaneous states, linear symbols and standard Gaussian identities only. No original source simulation or final VOR was reproduced.

normalization.energy: G=1, alpha=kappa/n0, hence G*kappa=n0*alpha; rational nondimensional examples, not dimensional parameter inference.
normalization.rate: A coherent rational normalization absorbs 4*pi into units; Gaussian dimensional reasoning is checked separately.
normalization.Fourier: Exact full finite convolution, no truncation/dealiasing; mean is zero Fourier coefficient on [0,2pi]^2.
normalization.inertia: All de^2 Laplacian terms and full generalized-flux advection retained for energy tests; de^2=0 is only a mathematical limiting control.

dimensional.context: Dimensional main Eq2 versus Appendix A2; not a secretly inferred simulation normalization.

hermite.collision_operator: set identically zero; convention not assessed

limits: AM is distinct from the uninspected subscription VOR.
Supplement identities refer only to arXiv v2; final journal supplement not inspected.
No author implementation, raw diagnostics, reconnection curve or heating calculation is inferred.
Rate and decay checks retain the source assumptions and suppress order-one sheet prefactors.
The source explicitly labels its ideal-ERMHD flux-breaking extension hypothetical.
No quantitative reanalysis of the published energy/equipartition plots is possible from these controls.
